1.consolidated_definition: Erudito, estudioso. Intelectual especialista en una rama particular del conocimiento. Anglicismo crudo, frecuente. Tenacidad, talento y brillantez tuvo que derrochar Arrom seguramente para mantenerse en aquel ambiente de privilegiados, sin que ello, sin embargo, le convirtiera en un scholar de la Nueva Inglaterra de la época, ni le hiciera perder su cubanía y su amor a su tierra y a sus gentes (Consejo General de Taínos Borincanos, 28-06-07)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Erlidito, estudioso. Intellectually specialized individual in a particular branch of knowledge. Raw Anglicism, frequent. Tenacity, talent, and brilliance must have been wasted by Arrom to maintain himself in that environment of privileged individuals, without it, however, turning him into a scholar of the New England of the time, nor making him lose his Cuban heritage and his love for his land and people (Consejo General de Taínos Borincanos, 28-06-07)
